answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond in a single-identity escrow before it can trade, so spawning a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds — a cedar of cost that grows with each clone. The nadir is bond recycling: one deposit backing many identities through flash loans. The check is to audit the escrow ledger so the same collateral can never back two identities, and slash the bond of any agent proven to share one, pushing honest agents toward the zenith of trust.
